question: What should be said after showing the tattva-mudrā in this Kaula food-rite?
inference: the rite prescribes saying this food-nectar after displaying the tattva-mudrā
uncertainties: exact referent of tattva-mudrā is not specified

plain_english: Having shown the tattva-mudrā, one should then say, 'This is the food-nectar.'
